scenes.label: Before
scenes.voiceover: Here's a song I downloaded. Mariah Carey, Bye Bye. And look at the file in Explorer. No cover art. Just a plain icon. Let's fix that.

scenes.label: Open the app
scenes.voiceover: I'll open Audio Album Art Embedder, and choose the folder with my music.

scenes.label: Cover detected
scenes.voiceover: It finds the song, and it spots the cover image on its own. There's the preview. If it picked the wrong one, I can choose a different image.

scenes.label: Embed
scenes.voiceover: Everything's ticked, so I just click, Embed cover art.

scenes.label: Done
scenes.voiceover: And that's it. One of one file updated. Just keep in mind, the file is changed in place, so keep a backup if it matters.

scenes.label: After
scenes.voiceover: Back in Explorer, it's the same file, and now the cover shows up as its thumbnail. Before, and after.

scenes.label: End
scenes.voiceover: It works with MP3, FLAC, M4A and AAC files. Try it on a copy of your own music folder.
